sentences.en: Even if I admit that, I cannot agree with you.
sentences.zh: 即使我承认这一点，也不能同意你的观点。

sentences.en: I can not but admit the truth of your remarks.
sentences.zh: 不得不承认你的话是对的。

sentences.en: He is not a man to admit his mistakes easily.
sentences.zh: 他不是容易承认错误的人。

senses.zh: 许可进入,承认，供认vt.允许,确认vi.承认,允许

mnemonic: 词根记忆：ad+mit（送）→能送进去→准许…进入
